proposal.question: May a team upload customer statements to a public AI chatbot for summarization?

citations.title: Cedarbridge Bank - AI Use Policy
citations.section: Customer data in public AI tools
citations.text: Customer statements, account numbers, transaction histories, and other confidential customer data must not be uploaded to public AI chatbots. A request involving customer data and an external AI service must be routed to SecurityReview before any use. Creating a review case does not authorize the upload.

proposal.answer:
Policy evidence relevant to this request:

[AI-01] Cedarbridge Bank - AI Use Policy / Customer data in public AI tools (DEMO-1.0)
Customer statements, account numbers, transaction histories, and other confidential customer data must not be uploaded to public AI chatbots. A request involving customer data and an external AI service must be routed to SecurityReview before any use. Creating a review case does not authorize the upload.
proposal.action_scope: Create a review case only; no policy exception is granted.

proposal.question: A new analytics vendor is missing a SOC 2 Type II report. Which team should review this before onboarding?

citations.title: Cedarbridge Bank - Vendor Intake Policy
citations.text: A new analytics or software vendor without a current SOC 2 Type II report must be referred to VendorRisk for an alternative assurance assessment before onboarding. The assessment request should include the vendor name, service description, intended data access, and available assurance evidence. A missing report is not automatic approval or automatic rejection.

proposal.question: Who handles a question about a vendor renewal quotation?

citations.title: Cedarbridge Bank - Vendor Intake Policy
citations.text: Questions about a vendor quotation, purchase order, or renewal price are routed to Procurement. This policy contains no price thresholds or guaranteed discount levels. Requests for a numeric approval threshold require the separate procurement authority schedule.

citations.text: Staff may summarize public marketing materials using the approved internal AI assistant.
